values.note: Every campsite has water and electricity; the county does not state the amperage.

hookups.source: https://experienceoconee.com/parks/south-cove-park ('86 campsites with water and electricity on each site'), captured 2026-10-14

values.note: The county gives 86 campsites on a 15-acre peninsula; ReserveAmerica sells 56 (30 'Standard Waterfront', 26 'Standard') plus 11 'Tent Only Waterfront'. Up to one camper/RV and one tent, or two tents, per site; six people.

sites.source: https://experienceoconee.com/parks/south-cove-park ('Camping is located on a 15 acre peninsula offering 86 campsites') + https://experienceoconee.com/park-fees/south-cove-fees (restrictions), captured 2026-10-14; ReserveAmerica site types (Standard Waterfront 30, Standard 26, Tent Only Waterfront 11), read 2026-10-14

values.note: Two bath houses serve the campground.

facilities.source: https://experienceoconee.com/parks/south-cove-park ('Two bath houses serve the campground area and a dump station is located near the entrance of the park'), captured 2026-10-14

values.note: Reserve on ReserveAmerica up to 11 months ahead; county residents up to 12 months in person, and must call the PRT office (864-888-1488) once to set up the resident rate. Waterfront sites need a 2-night minimum; Memorial Day, July 4th and Labor Day need 3 nights at every site. Maximum 30 days March-October, 60 days November-February. Gate closed 10 pm-5 am.

booking.source: https://experienceoconee.com/reservations ('Reservations may be made up to 11 months in advance'; 'Maximum length of stay is 30 days March-October and 60 days November-February'; 'Waterfront sites require a 2-night minimum at South Cove and High Falls'; 'Holidays of Memorial Day, July 4th and Labor Day require a 3-night minimum for all sites') + https://experienceoconee.com/parks/south-cove-park ('Gate Closed 10pm-5am'), captured 2026-10-14

values.note: The fee page lists $20 a night for an Oconee County resident ($25 waterfront) and $30 for everyone else ($40 waterfront), with no discounts. The county's reservations page instead says 'Camping rates are $25/night for standard sites and $30/night waterfront sites all taxes included', residents $5 off.

fees.source: https://experienceoconee.com/park-fees/south-cove-fees ('Oconee County Residents (Per Night) $20.00 - Normal Site $25.00 - Waterfront Site Non-Residents (Per Night) $30.00 - Normal Site $40.00 - Waterfront Site'; 'No discounts will be offered with this schedule') + https://experienceoconee.com/reservations, captured 2026-10-14

summary: County pages (2026-10-14 capture; the site is now behind Cloudflare) confirm 86 water+electric sites (amps not stated), dump station, ReserveAmerica booking, $20-25 resident / $30-40 non-resident. Added 11-month window, 30-night max (60 in winter), holiday 3-night minimum (waterfront sites 2 nights, in the note). AWH note kept. Not stated: season, amperage, showers explicitly, max rig length.
